Clear Preset Hint: This will remove old snapshots for {{name}}, keeping the latest version as the current baseline. This cannot be undone.
Clear Preset No History: No history snapshots to clean up
Hint: Modify a preset to create a snapsh: Modify any preset parameter to automatically create a history snapshot
No items in this range: No items in the selected range
Auto Scroll Desc: Automatically scroll to the bottom when new logs arrive
Clear Logs Hint: Are you sure you want to clear the log buffer? This cannot be undone, but it will not affect history snapshots.
Snapshot Now Title: Force-create a snapshot of the current preset, ignoring hash deduplication (useful for troubleshooting or marking key states)
Snapshot Skipped: No changes detected, snapshot not created
Master switch: Master switch (turn off to disable everything)
Debounce Delay Desc: How long to wait before saving after a change
Text Input Debounce Desc: Use a longer delay while typing to avoid frequent saves
Slider Release Save Desc: Only save when the slider is released (recommended)
Skip Unchanged Save Desc: Skip writing if the content has not changed (recommended)
Max History Per Preset Desc: Older snapshots will be removed when this limit is exceeded
Merge Window Desc: Merge consecutive edits into a single record within this period
Cleanup Size Desc: A warning is shown when storage exceeds this size
Switch Guard Desc: Automatically backup the current preset before switching (recommended)
Status Indicator Desc: Small dot next to the preset name (green/yellow/grey)
Notify On Save Desc: Show a toast notification each time a save happens
Debug Mode Desc: Print verbose logs to the browser console (the in-app log panel always records all levels)
Restore Irreversible: This action cannot be undone, but the current preset will be backed up first
Cleanup Action Hint: Each preset will keep its newest {{max}} records, older ones will be removed
Clear All Hint: This will permanently delete all {{count}} history snapshots
Reset Settings Hint: Restore all settings to their defaults?
Import Preview Verified: The file passed parsing and integrity checks. Nothing changes until you confirm.
Import Preview Overlap: {{presets}} presets overlap with current history; {{duplicates}} snapshots are identical.
Import Preview Conflict Detail: These snapshots share an ID but contain different data. Safe merge is disabled to prevent accidental overwrite.
Import Preview Merge Detail: Keep current history and add {{count}} new valid snapshots.
Import Preview Merge Blocked: This file contains snapshots with the same ID but different content, so safe merge is unavailable.
Import Preview Replace Detail: Clear current history, then write this file. A failed write is rolled back automatically.
Import Preview Replace Removes: This removes {{count}} existing preset histories that are not in the file.
Import Preview No Changes: Current history was not changed. Update SillyTavern and try again, or use a conflict-free backup.
Import Preview Fallback Summary: Verified {{presets}} presets and {{snapshots}} snapshots. Only safe merge is available in this environment.
Purge Corrupt Title: Scan and remove broken snapshots (preset is empty / has too few fields)
Purge Corrupt Hint: This will scan all snapshots and remove any that are clearly corrupted (preset is empty or has fewer than 5 fields).
Purge Corrupt Detail: These bad snapshots are usually leftovers from earlier broken versions. Restoring them would clear your preset.
Purge Corrupt Done: Purged {{cleaned}} corrupt snapshot(s) out of {{scanned}} scanned
Pinned Done: Snapshot pinned — it will not be auto-cleaned
Cannot Delete Pinned: Pinned snapshots cannot be deleted. Unpin first.
Rename Hint: Give this snapshot a memorable name (max 80 chars). Leave empty to clear.
Diff Need Two: Pick two snapshots first (A and B)
Diff Same Snapshot: A and B are the same snapshot
Diff Show All Desc: Show fields that are identical in addition to changed ones
Diff Swap Title: Swap which snapshot is on which side
Diff Cross Series Not Allowed: Cannot compare snapshots from different series. Please select two snapshots within the same series.
Diff Not Same Family: These two snapshots do not belong to the same grouping family and cannot be compared.
Fallback Polling Desc: Periodically scan the preset for changes (off by default; only enable if events miss saves on your ST version)
Summary Runtime Only: Runtime state changed only (not part of preset content)
Grouping Enabled Desc: Group different versions of the same preset (e.g. DreamThinker V1 / V2) under one series. The history panel becomes 3-level (series → version → snapshots).
Grouping Prompt On Import Desc: Show a popup when an imported preset looks similar to an existing series, so you can confirm or correct it.
Grouping Default Expand Desc: Which series should be expanded by default when opening the panel.
Grouping First Scan Hint: Found {{count}} presets. Want to organize them into series groups so different versions of the same preset live together?
Grouping Import Detected Hint: The new preset "{{name}}" looks similar to existing series "{{series}}". Add it to that series?
Grouping Manage Hint: Manually assign each preset to a series (leave empty = use auto-detection) or check "ungrouped".
Grouping Manage Desc: Drag presets between groups to reorganize.
Grouping Reset All Confirm: Reset all manual grouping overrides? You can undo this until the group manager closes.
启用嵌套分组_desc: When enabled, you can create multi-level grouping (up to 3 levels) by dragging groups to nest them.
请输入子分组名称: Enter a name for the new subgroup:
分组名已存在: Group name already exists, please use a different name.
删除分组含子分组: This group contains {count} subgroup(s). Deleting it will move them up one level. Confirm?
不能将分组移动到自己的子分组下: Cannot move a group under its own subgroup (circular reference).
分组移动深度超限: Target is at maximum nesting depth ({max} levels), cannot nest further.
拖拽分组到目标分组: Drag a group onto another to nest
Takeover Enabled Desc: Merge multiple versions of the same series into a single "series name" entry in the native dropdown for a clean, organized list. Disabling restores the original list immediately.
Takeover Default Expand Hint: When off, only the group containing the currently selected preset is expanded when opening the dropdown.
Takeover Default Strategy Desc: When no default is set for a series, automatically use the latest version.
Set As Default Version: Set as the default applied version for this series
Unset Default Version: Clear the default applied version for this series
Default Apply Tag Title: Selecting this series in the native dropdown will automatically apply this version
No Snapshots Yet Title: This version has no snapshots yet (will be created automatically when modified)
No Snapshots Yet Hint: No history snapshots for this version yet. Modify any parameter to create the first snapshot.
Auto Seed Enabled Desc: When takeover/grouping is first enabled, automatically create an "initial snapshot" for every existing preset so they appear in the three-level panel right away (no need to modify them first).
Reseed Snapshots: Scan all presets and create snapshots
Reseed Snapshots Desc: Create an "initial snapshot" for every preset that has no snapshots yet, so the panel shows the complete three-level structure immediately.
Reseed All Already Done: All {{total}} presets already have snapshots, nothing to do
Seed Snapshots Done: Created initial snapshots for {{added}} presets ({{total}} total)
Archived Version Title: In data takeover mode, this version has been deleted from SillyTavern and archived locally. It will be auto-restored when uninstalling the extension.
Duplicate Version Title: This is a copy number for a duplicate preset name, not an error
Clear Preset Also Remove From ST Confirm: Also delete this preset from SillyTavern?
Clear Preset Also Remove From ST Hint:
Snapshots of {{name}} have been cleared, but the preset itself still exists in SillyTavern.

Do you want to also remove it from the SillyTavern preset list?

⚠ This cannot be undone. If unsure, select No to only clear the snapshot history.
Clear Preset ST Delete Failed: Snapshots cleared, but failed to delete preset from SillyTavern
Panel Open Failed: Preset history could not be loaded.
Panel Open Recovery Hint: Close and reopen the panel. If the problem continues, check the extension logs before changing history data.
Export Preset A Title: Export snapshot A as a complete preset JSON file
Export Preset B Title: Export snapshot B as a complete preset JSON file
Restore Cross Preset Warning: This snapshot belongs to "{{snapshotPreset}}". Please switch to that preset first before restoring.
Grouping Undo Conflict: Grouping changed elsewhere, so the old undo history was disabled. Current data was not overwritten.
Grouping Move Cycle Error: Cannot move this group inside one of its descendants because that would create a cycle.
Grouping Move Depth Error: Cannot move this group there because the {{max}}-level nesting limit would be exceeded.
Grouping Group Exists: A group named "{{name}}" already exists. Choose another name.
Grouping Delete Children Confirm: This group contains {{count}} subgroups. Deleting it moves them up one level. Continue?
Grouping Subgroup Depth Error: The maximum nesting depth has been reached, so another subgroup cannot be created here.
Grouping Delete Group Confirm: Remove custom group "{{name}}"? Presets will return to auto-detect.
Delete Preset Confirm: Permanently delete preset "{{name}}"? This cannot be undone.
Delete Preset Current Warning: Cannot delete the currently active preset. Please switch to another preset first.
Batch Delete Confirm: Permanently delete {{count}} presets? This cannot be undone. Enter the number {{count}} to confirm:
Grouping Alias Error Duplicate: A group already uses this name
Grouping Alias Error Save: This name could not be saved. Try again
